title: Avocado, Cherry Tomato and Black Bean Salad
subtitle: with Quinoa
description: If you're looking for something healthy with lots of contrasting textures and flavours, we've got it covered. Think creamy avo, crunchy pepitas and sweet tomatoes with wholesome quinoa and black beans in a zesty tomato dressing.

steps.text: Cook quinoa: Rinse 100g (½ cup) quinoa (see Make it yours) well in a sieve, then drain. Put in a small saucepan with 180ml (¾ cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 12-15 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for 5 mins.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Finely chop 2 tomatoes, reserving the remainder. Pick the coriander leaves, discarding the stems. Finely chop half the coriander leaves. Finely grate the zest of half the lime, then juice the half. Drain and rinse the black beans.

Make tomato dressing: Put the garlic, chopped tomato, chopped coriander leaves, lime zest, lime juice, 2 tsp white wine vinegar, 2 tsp olive oil and ½ tsp honey in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Put the pepitas in a small cold frypan over medium heat and toast, tossing, for 1-2 mins until evenly golden. Remove the pan from the heat.

Prep salad: Put the quinoa and black beans in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir for 2-3 mins until the quinoa is slightly cool. Add half the tomato dressing and stir gently to combine. Cut the reserved tomatoes in half. Cut the avocado into quarters.

Serve up: Divide the quinoa mixture among plates and top with the halved tomatoes, avocado and remaining coriander leaves. Drizzle over the remaining tomato dressing. Scatter over the toasted pepitas and enjoy.

Make it yours: To keep within our healthy eating guidelines, we are using only 100g quinoa. However, if you wish to add all the quinoa, the dish will still taste delicious. Simply add an extra 60ml (¼ cup) water to the pan when cooking the quinoa.
